cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para
# inconsistent: two contradictory measurements
p = {'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,2,4],[0,1,5,6]]}
r = para.calibrate(p)
print(r)
# multi-hop: x1-x0 in [1,2], x2-x1 in [3,4] => x2-x0 in [4,6]
p2 = {'groups':3,'jitter_ps':[0,0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,1,2],[1,2,3,4]]}
r2 = para.calibrate(p2)
print(r2)
# check witness validity
cal = para.Calibration(p2)
for a in range(3):
  for b in range(3):
    if a==b: continue
    cid = cal.pred[a][b]
    tot=0; cur=b
    while True:
      e = cal.edges[cid]
      assert e[1]==cur, (a,b,cid,e)
      tot += e[2]
      if e[0]==a: break
      cur = e[0]; cid = cal.pred[a][cur]
    assert tot == cal.upper[a][b], (a,b,tot,cal.upper[a][b])
print('witness ok')
"
